verdict.rationale: Factory documents an official Droid SDK for TypeScript that runs the same agent harness behind its CLI, desktop app, and web platform from your own code. A sessions API reference and a published OpenAPI spec back it up as an official programmatic surface. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in more than one language (only TypeScript shown), in-depth SDK documentation detail (setup, API surface, examples), independent or hands-on corroboration.
